keyEvents.text: Artemijus Tutyskinas (Celje) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lukasz Bejger (Celje).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Celje. Zan Zuzek replaces Lukasz Bejger because of an injury.
Substitution, Celje. Armandas Kucys replaces Blaz Kramer.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Krisztián Lisztes replaces Lenny Joseph.
Substitution, Celje. Yaya Dukuly replaces Benjamin Verbic.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Callum O'Dowda replaces Daniel Arzani.
Substitution, Ferencváros. Jonathan Levi replaces Matús Bero.
Substitution, Celje. Papa Daniel replaces Mario Kvesic.
